name: traces_client_error_ratio_anomaly
title: Outbound call error ratio is unusually high
description: Share of CLIENT spans (outbound calls to dependencies) with status ERROR is above its learned band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets. Unit: ratio 0-1. Ratios are floored at 1% (0.01) and buckets with fewer than 50 client spans report the floor, so it never fires below roughly 1.2% or on low traffic; above that it fires when the ratio is roughly 15% or more above its learned level. Edit the two constants in custom_sql to tune. Whole stream; add AND service_name = '...' to the WHERE clause after install for a per-service alert (one config per service). Needs applications sending OpenTelemetry traces to the traces stream named default.

anomaly_config.custom_sql: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5m') AS time_bucket, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 50 THEN 0.01 ELSE GREATEST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), 0.01) END AS error_ratio FROM "default" WHERE span_kind = '3' GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket
